title: Story premise EDU048: The Icon That Meant Two Things
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: Will this star save it, or score it? Takeaway/theme: An icon’s meaning may need context, labeling, and user checking.
description: A designer wants a button understood without explanation, but two viewers read the same star as favorite and rating. Pairing it with a clear label and checking the intended action resolves the prototype confusion.
